blocks.prompt: 8. Find the equations of the tangent and normal to the parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) at the point \((at^{2}, 2at)\).
blocks.explanation:
Point \((at^{2}, 2at)\) ko pehchaniye: yeh \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ka \(t\)-point hai, jo 6.3.2 mein seekha. Is liye yeh yaqeenan parabola par hai.
6.3.5 mein humne \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) par tangent \(yy_{1} = 2a(x + x_{1})\) nikala tha.
Ab bas \(x_{1} = at^{2}\), \(y_{1} = 2at\) rakhna hai, aur simplify karna hai.
Normal ki slope tangent ki slope ka negative reciprocal hogi.
Yeh nataij aage bahut kaam aate hain, is liye inhein formula ki tarah yaad kar lena faidemand hai: \(t\)-point par tangent \(ty = x + at^{2}\) aur normal \(y = -tx + 2at + at^{3}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y^{2} = 4ax\); point \((x_{1}, y_{1}) = (at^{2}, 2at)\).
Maloom karna: is point par tangent aur normal.
Tareeqa: 6.3.5 ke nataij.

Tangent
\[y(2at) = 2a(x + at^{2})\]
\[ty = x + at^{2}\]
Kyun: \(yy_{1} = 2a(x + x_{1})\) mein values rakhi, phir dono taraf \(2a\) se divide kiya (\(a \ne 0\)).
Dhyan dein: \(2at \cdot y\) ko \(2a\) se divide karne par sirf \(ty\) bachta hai.

Normal ki slope
Tangent ki slope \(= \frac{2a}{y_{1}} = \frac{2a}{2at} = \frac{1}{t}\), is liye normal ki slope \(-t\).
Kyun: perpendicular lines ke liye \(m_{1}m_{2} = -1\): \(\frac{1}{t} \times (-t) = -1\).

Normal
\[y - 2at = -t(x - at^{2})\]
\[y - 2at = -tx + at^{3}\]
\[y = -tx + 2at + at^{3}\]
Kyun: point-slope form, point \((at^{2}, 2at)\) se.
Dhyan dein: \(-t \times (-at^{2}) = +at^{3}\).

Tasdeeq:
Point dono lines par hai: \(t(2at) = at^{2} + at^{2}\), aur \(-t(at^{2}) + 2at + at^{3} = 2at\). Tangent hone ki tasdeeq: \(x = ty - at^{2}\) ko \(y^{2} = 4ax\) mein rakhein: \(y^{2} - 4aty + 4a^{2}t^{2} = (y - 2at)^{2} = 0\), dohra root. \(t = 0\) (vertex) par formulas tangent \(x = 0\) aur normal \(y = 0\) dete hain, jo bhi sahi hai. Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
Ek misaal se dekh lein: \(a = 1\), \(t = 2\) par point \((4, 4)\); tangent \(2y = x + 4\) aur normal \(y = -2x + 12\). Dono point \((4, 4)\) se guzarte hain aur in ki slopes \(\frac{1}{2}\) aur \(-2\) ka product \(-1\) hai.
